node: Indium phosphide wafers and optical-interconnect substrates
summary: Layer 1B expands the US-listed universe around the InP wafer/substrate and optical-interconnect chokepoint. The strongest direct public-market mapping is AXTI as an InP substrate producer with China export-permit exposure. LITE and COHR are reference leaders because they disclose InP-based lasers, photonic chips, datacom transceivers, and AI data-center optical links. AAOI enters the underfollowed lane as a smaller vertically integrated optical transceiver and laser-chip candidate whose exposure appears tied to InP laser-diode capacity and hyperscaler 800G/1.6T demand, but requires filing-level confirmation of InP revenue, customer concentration, and substrate sourcing.
